text: Literally speaking, roads do not all converge on a single point but rather connect various destinations within an extensive network of paths and intersections. While the proverb "all roads lead to Rome" suggests a unified endpoint in ancient times, modern infrastructure demonstrates that routes diverge toward countless different locations based on their specific design and purpose. Therefore, there is no universal final destination for every road; instead, they collectively form a complex system leading to diverse outcomes. CONFIDENCE: 95
